FM Madhesh Kumar of Pondicherry played an excellent game against GM Mamikon Gharibyan in the 1st round of the 1st Chola Chess International Grandmasters Tournament.
In this video, Madhesh analysed his game and also talked about the significance of Chola Chess in his chess journey.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Devansh Singh
